extracted.intended_audience: health journalists, consumers of medical news, and others interested in evaluating accuracy of health reporting
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and high-level standards for evaluating and producing news stories about medical treatments, tests, products and procedures. Emphasizes the ABCs of health journalism (Accuracy, Balance, Completeness) and presenting medical evidence in an unbiased, decision-focused way.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of the site's stated 'ABCs of health journalism' — Accuracy is a core goal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Improving the accuracy of news stories about medical treatments, tests, products and procedures. The site is dedicated to ensuring reporting correctly represents the evidence and claims about health interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the 'ABCs of health journalism' — Balance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helping consumers evaluate the evidence for and against new ideas in health care; presenting competing viewpoints and tradeoffs so readers can see the full context of a claim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the 'ABCs of health journalism' — Completeness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure news stories include the necessary information for readers to understand the evidence and make informed judgments (e.g., benefits, harms, alternatives, quality of evidence).

rubrics_metrics.name: Organize and frame medical evidence in an unbiased manner
rubrics_metrics.description: A stated objective of the supporting Foundation: to 'Organize and frame medical evidence in an unbiased manner to help people evaluate their options.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews and coverage should present evidence objectively and without slant; framing should aid consumers' evaluation of options, especially where individual preferences affect choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote informed medical decision-making
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation’s mission includes promoting understanding and adoption of informed medical decision-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content should help people understand their choices and have the information needed to make sound decisions affecting their health and well being; this underpins evaluation criteria for stories and reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide information that is objective, complete and unbiased
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit commitment: 'provide information that is as objective, complete and unbiased as possible.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Particular attention is warranted because 'cost savings, commercial interests or professional beliefs and commitments are likely to drive medical decisions.' Coverage should therefore avoid commercial or professional bias and strive for completeness and objectivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Star review rating (0–5) — searchable metric
rubrics_metrics.description: The site uses a 0-5 star review rating for stories (searchable by '0 - 5 star').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Navigation/search note: users may search reviews by '0 - 5 star' rating (e.g., '3 star' or '1 star'); the site also references 'How is the Star Score Determined' indicating a quantitative scoring system underlies reviews.
